title_cn: 食品工业如何应对环孢子虫爆发

Bloomberg Businessweek's Deena Shanker joins Max Chafkin and Stacey Vanek Smith on the Everybody's Business podcast to discuss how the food industry is dealing with the growing health crisis. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Treasuries Rally as Soft Jobs Data Trims Fed Rate-Hike Bets
title_cn: 就业数据疲软削弱美联储加息押注，美国国债上涨
summary:
US Treasuries rallied after data showed employers unexpectedly cut jobs in July, suggesting labor market challenges that could impact the Federal Reserve’s willingness to raise interest rates.

The yield on two-year US Treasuries, which are sensitive to near-term moves in Fed monetary policy, fell as much as nine basis points on Friday to 4.15% as traders cut bets on interest-rate hikes in the coming months. The moves were pared later in the New York trading session as oil rose, though the two-year yield remained about four basis points lower on the day near 4.20%. We get reaction from Tom Tzitzouris, Head of Fixed Income Research at Baird Strategas. (Source: Bloomberg)

Hottovy of Placer.ai research covers the space and joins "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: President Donald Trump said he would appeal to the Supreme Court after a federal appeals court ruled he lacks the legal authority to build his sprawling White House ballroom without congressional approval.

title: US Army to Speed Firms’ Access at Ranges For Weapons Tests
title_cn: 美国陆军加快企业进入武器测试范围
summary: The US Army wants to make it easier for defense firms to get access to military test ranges to experiment with critical weapons technology, in the latest effort to shake up Pentagon procurement and replenish stockpiles drained by the war against Iran.

title: Trump and Fed Chair Warsh Talk 'All the Time,' Hassett Says
title_cn: 哈塞特表示，特朗普和美联储主席沃什“一直在交谈”
summary: President Trump and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh talk about the economy “all the time,” National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett says on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Hassett says he's sure Trump is not telling Warsh what to do about interest rates.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Cassidy Backs Blanche, Paving Way for Trump’s Attorney General
title_cn: 卡西迪支持布兰奇，为特朗普的司法部长铺平道路
summary: Republican Senator Bill Cassidy said he will support Todd Blanche to be the next attorney general, likely paving the way for his confirmation.
